title: Edexcel GCSE Physics
description:
Complete Edexcel GCSE Physics course covering the 1PH0 specification.

Topics include:
• Key concepts of physics
• Motion and forces
• Conservation of energy
• Waves
• Light and the electromagnetic spectrum
• Radioactivity
• Astronomy
• Energy - Loss and transfer
• Electricity
• Static electricity
• Magnetism and electromagnetism
• Particle model
• Forces and matter

Includes worked examples, practice problems, and exam-style questions.
subject: physics
